name: Zaō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Zaō town emblem in purple: a ring beneath a crown-like device with wing-like strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Zaō, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 March 1959.

features.role: Zaō town emblem — a ring beneath a crown-like device with wing-like strokes
